# Kahel Studio

> Professional photography studio in Tabaco City, Albay, Philippines, founded in 2022. Specializing in portrait sessions, debut, christening, birthday, and event photography across Bicol and Luzon.

## Services

- [Studio Sessions](https://kahelstudio.com/#services): Solo (₱1,500), Duo (₱1,800), Group (₱2,199), Theme (₱3,000), Express (₱2,500), and Mini Session (₱999) — all shot in-studio in Tabaco City, Albay.
- [Event Photography](https://kahelstudio.com/#services): Debut (₱10,000), Christening (₱8,000), Birthday (₱7,000), Anniversary Celebration (₱10,000), Engagement Party (₱6,000), and Baby Shower (₱5,000) coverage across Luzon.

## Booking

Book a session at https://kahelstudio.com/#book. Accepts 50% downpayment or full payment online via GCash, Maya, GrabPay, card, QR Ph, or cash on arrival.
